title: BSSC 2019
text:
The British Schools Score Championships took place on October 12th in Heaton Park, Manchester, in excellent weather. James achieved a silver medal in the Year 5 Boys class with 150 points, just 10 points behind the winner, & his brother Ben finished 10th in the highly competitive Year 10/11 Boys class. Both the boys' and girls' teams from Barnardiston Hall School were placed second in the Middle Schools Category. Congratulations to all who took part.
